_comment: GAME_PLAN 22.2 SPAWN presets. D in m; lead in years (0 = NO WARNING, sunward); type is a threat type id; vInf km/s if fixed. Elements are built by the collision construction at round start, so every scenario hits if ignored.

scenarios.name: 2013 CHELYABINSK
scenarios.note: 18 m, airburst over Russia; nobody saw it coming

scenarios.name: 1908 TUNGUSKA
scenarios.note: about 55 m, flattened 2000 km2 of forest; three weeks of warning here

scenarios.name: 2024 YR4
scenarios.note: the 2032 scare that peaked at 3%; a city-killer class rubble pile

scenarios.name: 99942 APOPHIS
scenarios.note: 340 m; the 2029 close pass is real, this impact is not

scenarios.name: 101955 BENNU
scenarios.note: 490 m rubble pile sampled by OSIRIS-REx; 1-in-2700 for 2182

scenarios.name: DIMORPHOS (DART)
scenarios.note: DART's target, 160 m; replay the real push: 580 kg at 6.1 km/s, beta 3.6

scenarios.name: CHICXULUB
scenarios.note: 10 km; the one that ended the Cretaceous. Good luck.
